products.title: Cu Skin
products.body_html:
Description

Discover the power of copper peptides for radiant, resilient skin. Cu Skin harnesses Copper Tripeptide-1 (GHK-Cu), an ingredient that supports your skin’s natural repair processes. This lightweight cream combines aloe leaf juice for deep hydration and Kakadu plum extract for vitamin C, all in a formula that works with your body, not against it.

     

Key Ingredients

Aloe barbanesis Leaf Juice, Caprlylic/Capric Triglyceride, Glycerin, Hydroxyethyl Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, Pentapeptide-18, Terminalia ferdinandiana Fruit Extract, Copper Tripeptide-1, Tocopherol Acetate, Xanthan Gum, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Caprylyl Glycol, Citric Acid.

Suggested Use

Apply 2-3 pumps to the face and desired areas daily. Avoid contact with eyes.

products.title: Cu Hair
products.body_html:
Description

Great hair starts at the scalp. Cu Hair is formulated with Copper Tripeptide-1 (GHK-Cu) to support scalp conditions associated with natural hair growth, thickness, and hydration. Copper peptides help improve and maintain a scalp environment that your hair follicles need to support strong, healthy strands. Combined with botanical extracts from amaranths and grape seed, this spray works at the scalp level to nourish hair at the root.

   

Key Ingredients

Ingredient List:  Aqua (Water), Amaranthus Caudatus Seed Extract, Gluconolactone, Sodium Benzoate, Calcium Gluconate, Cetrimonium Chloride, PEG-8 Dimethicone, Vitis Vinifera (grape) Seed Extract, Copper tripeptide-1, D-panthenol, Polysorbate 80, Sodium Gluconate, Fragrance.

Suggested Use

Directions: Shake well. Spray 2-3 pumps directly to clean, dry scalp, focusing on areas of concern. Gently massage for even distribution & wait 5-10 minutes before applying styling products. Use daily AM or PM. Avoid contact with eyes.

products.title: Ivím Travel Case with Ice Pack
products.body_html:
Description

Ivím's Travel Case is the perfect companion for your GLP-1 medication, hormone therapy, or any other injectable supplements on the go*. Designed in-house by Ivím, this custom faux-leather case combines style, durability, and practicality to keep your health essentials safe and discreet—whether you’re heading to the office, the gym, or a weekend getaway.

Inside, you’ll find a branded Ivím ice pack to maintain temperature-sensitive medications, a small mesh pouch for alcohol pads or swabs, and two storage compartments for vials, pen devices, or other supplies. An expandable elastic strap securely holds your pens or syringes in place, preventing movement during travel.
Lightweight, compact, and built for both function and style, the Ivím Travel Case ensures your treatment plan never misses a beat—wherever life takes you.

Key Features

✔ Designed by Ivím specifically for GLP-1 medications, hormone therapy, and other injectable supplements.

✔ Made from durable, easy-to-clean faux leather.

✔ Includes 1 branded Ivím reusable ice pack to help maintain temperature during travel.

✔ Features 2 storage compartments, 1 mesh pouch, and 1 expandable elastic strap.

✔ Compact size fits easily into handbags, backpacks, and carry-ons.

Product Specifications

Dimensions (In): 8.05" x 3.85" x 2.5"

Weight: 12 oz (0.75 pounds)

Material: Faux-leather exterior with concealed zipper closure. Mesh and elastic interior is breathable to support temperature regulation.

*Disclaimer: This travel case is not a medical device. It is intended for the storage and transport of personal items and medication supplies. Always follow your medication’s storage instructions provided by your healthcare provider or the product’s manufacturer. For temperature-sensitive medications, ensure appropriate temperature is maintained during travel. The included ice pack should be used in accordance with the medication’s temperature guidelines and is not a substitute for refrigerated storage. Ivím is not responsible for loss of medication efficacy due to improper storage.

Rénu is formulated using NMN + AstraGin® for those looking to support healthy aging, cellular energy, and metabolic function. NMN (nicotinamide mononucleotide) plays a key role in the body’s natural production of NAD⁺, a molecule used by cells to generate energy and maintain function over time.
